scope: New versioned Spark feature marts and independent Python validation; backend API files were not changed.

ANALYTICS-01.evidence: 22 versioned feature marts cover menu, customer, basket, demand, wastage, rating, price/promotion and transaction quality families.
ANALYTICS-01.remaining: Expose new marts through authenticated API/UI without changing the existing backend contract.

ANALYTICS-02.evidence: 200 item rows include margin, rating proxy, repeat buyers, promotion dependency, 90-day trend, waste and location marts.
ANALYTICS-02.remaining: Rating is order-associated, not item-direct; add UI/API exposure and validate tricky cases end to end.

ANALYTICS-03.evidence: 75000 full customer rows include RFM, category/channel/time preference, promotion and visit features; 563 zero-order customers retained.
ANALYTICS-03.remaining: Independent segmentation agrees on dimensions but no UI/API surface or acceptance study yet.

ANALYTICS-04.evidence: 19900 persisted pair rows; support/lift formulas independently recomputed with zero maximum error.
ANALYTICS-04.remaining: Recommendation acceptance and cost/impact tracking remain unavailable.

ANALYTICS-05.evidence: Independent chronological item/category/location forecasts beat the 7-day seasonal-naive baseline on MAE and RMSE for all three levels.
ANALYTICS-05.remaining: Persist forecast artifacts and expose configurable horizons through the backend/UI.

ANALYTICS-06.evidence: Daily, weekly, reason and inventory-aligned wastage marts generated (107711 daily rows; 107711 inventory-aligned rows).
ANALYTICS-06.remaining: Preparation quantity is absent from canonical schema; predictive risk output is still the prior screening model.

ANALYTICS-07.evidence: Price events, promotion flags, customer repeat, margin, wastage and post-period monthly behavior are now joined in versioned marts.
ANALYTICS-07.remaining: Effects remain observational; no causal claim is made and API/UI exposure is pending.

ANALYTICS-08.evidence: Rating context by item/location/month/promotion and transaction-quality candidates are persisted for anomaly rules.
ANALYTICS-08.remaining: Add persisted rule thresholds/adjudication labels and expose anomaly evidence through API/UI.

ANALYTICS-10.evidence: Independent chronological disengagement model: ROC-AUC 0.5760, F1 0.6008; label uses >45-day gap to next observed customer month.
ANALYTICS-10.remaining: This is an observational next-gap model; validate future labels and expose it through API/UI before claiming production churn.

limitations: No preparation quantity exists in the canonical source schema.
Ratings are order-associated item proxies because source ratings have order/restaurant keys but no menu_item_id.
Promotion and price estimates are observational.
The application backend was deliberately left unchanged; new marts are evidence artifacts until a separately authorized API integration phase.
